description: Image Description: The image shows a metallic toaster placed on a sidewalk. The toaster is silver with two slots and is resting on a cracked concrete surface. Shadows from nearby objects or people are cast on the pavement, indicating a light source from the opposite direction. The scene is set outdoors, possibly during early morning or late afternoon
